# CI vision

Make architectural drift and distribution failures observable before release. The B0 workflow builds the same protocol/client/CEF stack on declared development platforms and preserves packages with provenance. Controlled hardware acceptance remains separate; later geometry and manufacturing corpora extend CI when those behaviors exist.
